newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Aeon Credit to issue 50 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Aeon Credit to issue 50 mln new shares.

text.p: Aeon Credit Service (Asia) Co Ltd said on Tuesday it plans to issue 50 million new shares at HK$2.40 each to raise a net HK$115 million for expanding its consumer financing business and repaying bank loans.
About 31.62 million new shares would be placed with private investors through agents Peregrine Capital Ltd, Baring Brothers Ltd and Nikko Securities (Asia) Ltd, it said in a statement.

Another 18.38 million shares would be subscribed by Aeon Credit Service Co Ltd, which will get 14.69 million, Jusco Stores (Hong Kong) Co Ltd, which will take 3.25 million and Jusco Co, which will buy 440,000 shares.
Consumer credit services provider and credit card issuer Aeon Credit Service (Asia) is a unit of Japan's Aeon Credit Service Co, which is controlled by Jusco Co.

The company said the price of HK$2.40 per share for placement and subscription, which represented 8.25 and 4.79 percent of the company's enlarged share capital, represented a 3.03 percent discount to Aeon's last close on Friday of HK$2.475.
Trading in the shares is expected to resume later on Tuesday after being suspended for one day, it added. -- Hong Kong newsroom (852) 2843 6369
